propositions: transport.py repeatedly hits the 800-LOC cap despite prior reactive splits (retry.py, transitions.py) that did not provide determined homes for new operations

The module's natural capability boundaries defined by _backend.py Protocols (_TicketTransport_, _SupportsLinks_, _SupportsComments_, _SupportsAbsenceProbe_) are not aligned with the file structure, forcing all new code to default to the god file

Splitting transport.py into capability-aligned mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) under 500 LOC each provides deterministic routing for future operations based on capability membership
The split must be mechanical (no behavior changes, no test edits, facade re-exports preserved) and land before subsequent parent-related work per operator approval
Regression hazard: 9bb9's _resolve_epic_link_field_id extraction and get_parent_map epic-link read logic must not be silently reverted by cherry-pick during the relocation
